name: Young jackfruit salad
summary: Boiled young jackfruit mixed with pork and shrimp, sweet-sour fish sauce, herbs, and sesame. Chicken is also added.
origin: Củ Chi. Jackfruit orchards here fruit through the year, and that this salad is eaten most in this district among southern versions.
howToEat: Boil young jackfruit and mix it with pork and shrimp, or with chicken. Sweet-sour fish sauce, herbs, cilantro, and sesame come with it. Eat it with rice, or as a plate with drinks.
seoTitle: Young jackfruit salad in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Young jackfruit salad with pork and shrimp, sweet-sour fish sauce, herbs, and sesame.
